title: Graduate Research Fellowship Program (GRFP)
description: Supports outstanding graduate students pursuing research-based master's and doctoral degrees in NSF-supported STEM disciplines. Awards three years of financial support including an annual stipend and cost-of-education allowance.
eligibility: US Citizens, nationals, or permanent residents pursuing full-time research MS or PhD in STEM fields.

title: Global Health Equity Scholars Program
description: Provides one-year mentored research training at premier institutions in low- and middle-income countries for graduate students and postdoctoral fellows focused on reducing global health disparities.
eligibility: Postdoctoral fellows and doctoral students in medicine, public health, or biomedical sciences.

title: Climate Solutions Accelerator Grant
description: Funds early-stage research projects with the potential to significantly reduce greenhouse gas emissions or enhance climate resilience. Open to researchers at any career stage with bold, unconventional approaches.
eligibility: Open globally to researchers, university labs, and independent non-profit scientific institutes.

title: AI for Social Good Research Awards
description: Supports academic research applying artificial intelligence and machine learning to pressing social challenges in areas such as healthcare, education, accessibility, and crisis response.
eligibility: Full-time faculty, postdoctoral researchers, and graduate students at accredited academic institutions.

title: Emerging Voices Fellowship
description: Supports early-career scholars from underrepresented communities conducting original research in the social sciences and humanities. Fellows receive a stipend, mentoring, and publication support.
eligibility: Recent PhD graduates (within 3 years) in anthropology, economics, political science, or sociology.

title: Biomedical Data Science Training Grant
description: Supports predoctoral and postdoctoral trainees developing expertise at the intersection of biomedical research and data science, including genomics, bioinformatics, and computational biology.
eligibility: Predoctoral students and postdocs conducting bioinformatics, computational biology, or biostatistics research.

title: Community-Based Participatory Research Award
description: Funds research partnerships between academic researchers and community organizations addressing social determinants of health and structural barriers to health equity.
eligibility: Academic-community collaborative teams working on public health and community wellbeing.

title: Quantum Computing Research Seed Fund
description: Provides seed funding and cloud access to IBM quantum processors for academic researchers developing quantum algorithms, error mitigation techniques, or quantum chemistry simulations.
eligibility: Academic researchers, faculty, and PhD candidates working on quantum computation or quantum physics.

title: International Peace and Conflict Resolution Research Grant
description: Supports policy-relevant research on the prevention, management, and resolution of violent conflict around the world. Encourages interdisciplinary approaches and non-traditional methodologies.
eligibility: Scholars, think-tank analysts, and researchers in international relations, political science, and peace studies.

title: Sustainable Agriculture and Food Systems Fellowship
description: Empowers early- to mid-career researchers advancing regenerative agriculture, food security, and climate-adapted crop development in vulnerable agricultural regions.
eligibility: Agronomy, climate science, ecology, and food systems scientists at universities or research centers.

title: MacArthur Fellows Program & Genius Grants
organization: John D. and Catherine T. MacArthur Foundation
description: Unrestricted fellowships awarded to exceptionally creative individuals with a track record of achievement and potential for significant future creative work across all fields.
eligibility: Nomination-based for scientists, artists, and innovators showing extraordinary originality and dedication.

title: Open Society Global Fellowship on Technology & Democracy
description: Supports researchers investigating algorithmic accountability, data privacy, surveillance tech, and digital rights in democratic processes.
eligibility: Journalists, legal scholars, computer scientists, and civil rights advocates working on tech ethics.
